values.goal: Coordinate provider shadow execution, milestone admission, quality, documentation review, and publication-candidate preparation as one fail-closed sequential sprint without absorbing child authority.
values.required_outcome: A validated Sprint Execution Packet and typed five-child batch are ready for issue-bound sessions with exact predecessor gates, proof lanes, and closeout rules.
authority_boundary: The umbrella owns sprint coordination records only; each child owns its implementation, proof, review, publication, finish, and cleanup.
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle only
Use issue-bound FastWork worktrees and issue-bound session goals
Do not implement child work inside the umbrella
Do not treat missing, skipped, zero-test, stale, or non-ancestral evidence as release admission
Do not merge, tag, release, or publish from Sprint 9 preparation
Do not retain credentials, private provider payloads, or private account data
